project.title: Native HTTP email verification and React recovery
project.goal: Expose native persisted verification through bounded same-origin request and token callback routes with truthful unknown outcomes
project.scope: HTTP/native synthetic control and UI recovery qualification; no production legacy writer closure or deployment

boundary.responsibility: Dispatch canonical native verification requests and completion with strict admission, fixed public outcomes and recovery UI
boundary.rationale: Crypto and application authority must survive HTTP parsing, optional caller and uncertain outcomes
excludes: Physical/lifetime or independently running legacy writer qualification, production rollout and full identity parity

action.http_verification.description: Native HTTP send/verify email and error recovery

errors.refused: Strict admission codes; native invalid token or explicit unconfirmed completion; all admitted request outcomes generic

preconditions: Trusted configured origin/profile and native handlers on admitted control handles
Exclusive canonical routing and old legacy writer drain before real enablement; no legacy proxy fallback
postconditions: Admitted POST returns same status/body after minimum500ms without existence/bearer/delivery claim; no automatic resend
GET validates callback before native mutation; only known commit yields success, unknown never does
HEAD/malformed queries and malformed named credentials cannot dispatch or downgrade to anonymous
React removes known error coordinate and offers recovery without login/resend side effects
external_effects: Native application issuance/postcommit injected mail or atomic completion under caller-owned writer
HTTP responses/redirect and bounded shared process rate/capacity state
React history replacement and explicit user resend only
